bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: Bears legend Mike Ditka, the Hall of Fame tight end and Super Bowl-winning head coach famously known as "Iron Mike" and "Da Coach," passed away Friday morning at age 86, according to an announcement from his family. Meanwhile, the Bears are preparing for their Week 5 matchup at Green Bay with Tyson Bagent set to start at quarterback in place of the injured Caleb Williams.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are gearing up for their Week 5 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals, with safety Brian Branch and center Cade Mays returning to practice, giving the team a boost after their recent struggles . Meanwhile, tight end Sam LaPorta's contract situation remains in the spotlight as he acknowledged a "stalemate" in contract negotiations with the team.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers signed running back Pierre Strong Jr. to the active roster from the practice squad ahead of Sunday's rivalry game against the Chicago Bears, as the team will likely be without running back Chris Brooks, with Strong promoted on Thursday as a potential replacement .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings (4-0) are heading into their Week 5 matchup against the New Orleans Saints while managing a banged-up roster, as the Vikings are waiting to see if they'll have their top receivers and left tackle for Sunday's game against the Saints . Jordan Addison has been dealing with a hamstring issue but warmed up with teammates and took limited reps while returning to practice on Thursday , while Justin Jefferson also hopes to return from injury for the Sunday matchup.
